mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, a.* FROM ( SELECT b.*, e.EMP_NAME FROM BOARD b JOIN EMP e ON b.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO ORDER BY b.GROUP_NO DESC, b.RE_STEP ASC ) a ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT b.BOARD_NO , b.EMP_NO , b.TITLE , b.BOARD_CONTENT , b.READ_COUNT , b.GROUP_NO , b.RE_LVL , b.RE_STEP , b.REGISTRAR , b.IN_DATE , e.EMP_NAME AS REGISTRAR_NAME FROM BOARD b JOIN EMP e ON b.REGISTRAR = e.EMP_NO WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO BOARD ( BOARD_NO , EMP_NO , TITLE , BOARD_CONTENT , READ_COUNT , GROUP_NO , RE_LVL , RE_STEP , REGISTRAR , IN_DATE
) VALUES ( BOARD_NO_SEQ.NEXTVAL , #{empNo} , #{title} , #{boardContent} , 0 , BOARD_NO_SEQ.CURRVAL , 0 , 0 , #{registrar, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , SYSDATE )
